trialScope: Pixel storage attribution; one buffer above 16 MiB; large conversions release the SDK lock; ordinary tiles retain scheduling; unchanged PDFium fonts/flags/resolution/colors and cache eviction accounting.
limitations: Pixel payload excludes allocator/GDI overhead. BGRA scope traces exclude gray DIB overlap and SDK allocations; they are not process peaks. Standalone font callback timing is not application startup. Warm caches and residual resources are not fully attributed. Non-gated memory runs do not isolate background CPU. No original upstream Release comparison or full unit suites.
decision: Deferred: controlled light-wide single-tab CPU median rises about 10%; stable builds retain the pretrial render path.

loadControlled.conditions: Light wide page 2, one tab; 24 cycles of 100/1600/25 zoom at 35ms. Independent Bun process samples CPU/memory while UI calls block the driver. Target is idle before measurement. Background CPU subtracts target CPU and includes harness/OS. Warm file cache, matching DLLs, hidden app PDBs, fresh settings. No builds or other GUI checks during measurement.

ownership.note: Ownership diagnostic, excluded from performance aggregates. App PDBs, including the recorded build-output path, are hidden. Cache Info policy sizes remain width*height*4 estimates. Pixel storage is stride*height, excluding allocator overhead and SDK state. Counters precede temporary Cache Info window creation. No forced trimming.
